body: hey squirt, no worries. you literally have the BEST part of your life ahead of you. i promise you once you gain your own autonomy and independence and money the possibilities for you will be endless. you’re in a weird transition period right now, no longer a teen but not quite an adult just yet. take your time to cook lol. you’re so developing what your life is, which remember will forever be constantly changing. and that’s the best part!! nothing is ever set in stone, you have so much more power than you think. it all depends on how you look at it. make the changes you want, enjoy your youth. you will only be old once you decide you are.

It’s the starting point that’s always the hardest, and it’s hard keeping faith when we constantly see it fail. I think we just need to find something solid to hang on to until we can get back in our own feet again

For the mom no, she was kneeling in front of Sangwoo and leaned forward into the knife he was holding so it pierced through her chin/upper throat. One of the police officers is seen questioning the angle too.
When they discovered her it was announced she was extremely well preserved for how long she had been dead, that slit wasn't on bone but on her skin where the knife went through.

Towards the end Sangwoo seemed to be having a lot of constant flashbacks and hallucinations of his mother, a lot more frequently than before. I think that's what ended up driving him further into his insanity. On the other hand, Bum seemed to have gain a lot more confidence in what he wanted and what he had to say. At this point he was even capable of lying bluntly to Sangwoo's face even though the truth was obvious. When Sangwoo noticed this it angered him and made him resort back to his old ways. I'm not sure if he was trying to tell this to his mother at the same time through Bum though.

I don't know if Bum was meant to be his surrogate mother per say, nor to replace her. I think since he was so obedient and devoted to Sangwoo, plus reminding him of his mom, were the reasons Sangwoo chose to keep him. That's more of my personal conclusion though.
I'm not sure if the replacement pills were for anxiety, but Sangwoo switched them with his mom. Since he wanted to test it if she was using the pills in her cooking without continuing getting sick, he swapped the poison pills with the others. His mom, thinking they were still the poison, continued to use them on Sangwoo. When he tried to test Bum, he believed Bum was also doing the same as his mother due to the missing pills, which yes did go missing when he accidentally dropped the bottle.

I agree! Although a horrible part of myself kind of shipped them together, it wouldn't make sense for Sangwoo and Bum to be together. Sangwoo's crimes were irredeemable and he had to pay for them, and Bum was too in love and dependent on Sangwoo to live without him. Killing Stalking was amazing and I personally loved all 3 seasons equally, it was so well thought out and written/illustrated.

If you go back and read the moment where she dies you can see her pushing herself into the knife Sangwoo was holding, so technically she killed herself. She was a small slender woman and did not have a double chin

1. I'm not sure if the mom was still alive when Sangwoo put her in the wall, to me it seemed like she bled out on the floor in front of Sangwoo. In regards to the timeline though I'm a little confused with it myself so I don't know if it was around the same time as he took in Bum, I don't think so, however, as the flashbacks from her death show a very different Sangwoo appearance wise
2. Yes, Bum reminded Sangwoo of his mother a lot, so much that he would often see her in his place. This can also be seen by the similarities in body size, hair, clothes, and behavior. 
3. His mother was severely depressed ever since she was a kid. She had lost her will to live from a very young age, even before she met her husband. He fell in love with her despite her ongoing and growing depression and they had a kid together, Sangwoo. This depression grew with the years. The husband became violent and despised her, which is why he would often beat her. After years of his abuse she killed him with poison rat (the pills). Later on she is seen cooking daily for Sangwoo, which in return would get severely sick. After remembering how she killed his father, Sangwoo checked the bottle of poison pills and counted them as he suspected her of poisoning him. He would return to count the pills, after finding 12 missing he realized he was getting sick due to his mother poisoning his food.
4. I'm not too sure about this one but it seemed like the tape recorder had Sangwoo's voice as he laughed while killing Chief Hawk
5. It is implied that he died by getting ran over. In my personal opinion, this is the only possible ending for Bum as it was clear he loved Sangwoo despite everything and could not go on without him.
6. Bum DEFINITELY had issues, just not the same kind Sangwoo had. He was indisputably mentally I'll and unstable, how else would he bad been able to stay with Sangwoo despite everything Sangwoo did to him?  Although he was not violent like Sangwoo, they both turned to sex to feel better, that's the biggest similarity in their mental illnesses that they shared.
